spans.s: शत n. (used in the singular with a plural noun, e.g. शतं देवाः; being then treated as a numerical adjective; it is also used as a noun with a gen., e.g. समानां शतम् ‘a century of years’; at the end of compounds शत is sometimes changed into शती, e.g. दशशती ‘ten hundred’) 1. A hundred, Megh.i.48, Bh.V.iv.36, M.viii.140; 2. any large number.
शात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Sharpened, whetted; 2. weak, feeble; 3. emaciated; 4. handsome, beautiful; 5. happy.
शात (II) m. The Dhattūra plant.
शात (III) n. Joy, happiness.
शात (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Sharpened, whetted; 2. weak, feeble; 3. emaciated; 4. handsome, beautiful; 5. happy.
सत्ता f. 1. Existence, being; 2. reality; 3. goodness, excellence.
शत-अक्षी f. 1. night; 2. an epithet of the goddess Durgā.
शत-अंग m. a car, a war-chariot.
शत-अर n. the thunderbolt of Indra.
शत-आनंद m. 1. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 2. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; 3. the car of Viṣṇu; 4. name of a son of Gotama and Ahalyā, the family-priest of king Janaka.
शत-आयुस् a. lasting or living one hundred years.
शत-आवर्त, -आवर्तिन् m. a name of Viṣṇu.
शत-आवर्त, -आवर्तिन् m. a name of Viṣṇu.
शत-ईश m. the ruler of a hundred villages, M.vii.11.
शत-कुंभ (I) m. name of a mountain where gold is found.
शत-कुंभ (II) n. gold.
शात-कुंभ, -कौंभ n. 1. gold, Sis.ix.9; 2. the Dhattūra plant.
शत-कृत्वस् ind. a hundred times, e.g.
इति यदि
शतकृत्वस्तत्वमालोचयामस्तदपि न हरिणाक्षीं विस्मरत्यंतरात्मा.
शत-कोटि (I) m. Indra’s thunderbolt.
शत-कोटि (II) f. a hundred crores.
शत-क्रतु m. an epithet of Indra, R.iii.38.
शत-खंड n. gold.
शत-गु a. possessed of a hundred cows.
शत-गुण a. hundred-fold.
शत-घ्नी f. 1. a kind of weapon used as a missile and described as a stone studded with iron spikes, (अयःकंटकसंछन्ना शतघ्नी महती शिला Vijayarakshita), R.xii.95; 2. a female scorpion.
शत-जिह्व m. an epithet of Śiva.
शत-तम a. the hundredth.
शत-तारका, -तारा, -भिषज्, -भिषा f. name of the 24th constellation containing one hundred stars.
शत-तारका, -तारा, -भिषज्, -भिषा f. name of the 24th constellation containing one hundred stars.
शत-तारका, -तारा, -भिषज्, -भिषा f. name of the 24th constellation containing one hundred stars.
शत-तारका, -तारा, -भिषज्, -भिषा f. name of the 24th constellation containing one hundred stars.
शत-द्रु f. name of a river in the Panjab, now called the Sutlej.
शत-धा ind. 1. in a hundred ways; 2. in a hundred parts.
शत-धामन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
शत-धार n. the thunderbolt of Indra.
शत-धृति m. 1. an epithet of Indra; 2. of Brahman (m.); 3. heaven.
शत-पत्र (I) m. 1. a peacock; 2. the Indian crane; 3. a species of parrot.
शत-पत्र (II) n. a lotus.
शत-पत्र˚योनि m. an epithet of Brahman (m.), कंपेन मूर्ध्नः शतपत्रयोनिम् (संभावयामास) K.S.vii.46.
शत-पत्रक m. the wood-pecker.
शातपत्रक m. Moonlight.
शत-पद्, -पाद् a. having a hundred feet.
शत-पद्, -पाद् a. having a hundred feet.
शत-पद्म n. 1. a lotus with a hundred petals; 2. the white lotus.
शत-पर्वन् (I) m. a bamboo.
शत-पर्वन् (II) f. the full-moon day in the month of Āśvina.
शत-भीरु f. a kind of jasmine.
शात-भीरु m. a kind of Mallikā.
शत-मख, -मन्यु m. 1. an epithet of Indra, K.S.ii.64, R.ix.13; 2. an owl.
शत-मख, -मन्यु m. 1. an epithet of Indra, K.S.ii.64, R.ix.13; 2. an owl.
शत-मुख a. 1. having a hundred ways; 2. having a hundred outlets or openings, विवेकभ्रष्टानां भवति विनिपातः शतमुखः Bhartr.ii.10 (where the word is used in both the senses).
शत-मुखी f. a brush.
शत-यष्टिक m. a necklace of one hundred strings.
शत-रूपा f. 1. name of the wife of Brahman (m.); 2. of his daughter.
शत-वेधिन् m. a sort of sorrel.
शत-शस् ind. 1. a hundred times, इदमाख्याहि शतशः Ve.vi.; 2. hundredfold, multifariously, Bg.xi.5.
शत-सहस्र n. a hundred thousand.
शत-साहस्र a. 1. containing or consisting of a hundred thousand; 2. bought with a hundred thousand.
शत-ह्रदा f. 1. lightning, K.S.vii.39; 2. Indra’s thunderbolt.
शतक (I) a. (f. का) Containing a hundred, a hundred.
शतक (II) n. A collection of hundred, a century, e.g. अमरुशतक ‘a collection of one hundred stanzas composed by Amaru.’
शतक (I) a. (f. का) Containing a hundred, a hundred.
शतिक a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a hundred; 2. bought with a hundred; 3. charged for a hundred; 4. effecting anything with a hundred; 5. containing or consisting of a hundred, Yaj.ii.208.
शतिक a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a hundred; 2. bought with a hundred; 3. charged for a hundred; 4. effecting anything with a hundred; 5. containing or consisting of a hundred, Yaj.ii.208.
शतिन् m. The owner of a hundred, e.g. निःस्वो वष्टि शतं शती दशशतम्.
शत्रि m. An elephant.
सत्त्रि m. 1. A cloud; 2. an elephant.
शत्रु m. 1. A destroyer, a conqueror; 2. an enemy, a foe; 3. a hostile neighbouring king.
शत्रु-उपजाप m. the treacherous whispering of an enemy.
शत्रु-कक्ष m. 1. the side of an enemy; 2. an antagonist, an enemy, an opponent.
शत्रुंजय m. an elephant.
शत्रु-दमन a. subduing an enemy.
शत्रुंतप a. subduing or destroying enemies.
शत्रु-हत्या f. foe-slaughter.
शत्वरी f. Night.
शात-उदरी f. a woman with a slender waist.
शात-कुंभ, -कौंभ n. 1. gold, Sis.ix.9; 2. the Dhattūra plant.
शातन n. 1. Sharpening, whetting; 2. becoming thin or small; 3. causing to wither or decay; 4. withering or decaying, e.g. वसंते सर्वशस्यानां जायते पत्रशातनम्.
शातपत्रकी f. Moonlight.
शातमान a. (f. नी) Bought with hundred.
शातमान a. (f. नी) Bought with hundred.
शात्रव (I) a. (f. वी) Hostile, belonging to an enemy, R.iv.42.
शात्रव (II) m. An enemy, Bt.v.81.
शात्रव (III) n. 1. A multitude of enemies; 2. enmity, hostility.
शात्रव (I) a. (f. वी) Hostile, belonging to an enemy, R.iv.42.
शात्रवीय a. (f. या) Relating to an enemy, inimical, hostile.
शात्रवीय a. (f. या) Relating to an enemy, inimical, hostile.

सत् (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Being, existing; 2. real, essential, true; 3. good, virtuous, chaste, सतीमपि ज्ञातिकुलैकसंश्रयां जनोऽन्यथा भर्तृमतीं विशकते Sak.v.; 4. excellent, best; 5. right, proper; 6. handsome, beautiful; 7. venerable, respectable; 8. wise, learned; 9. firm, steady.
सत् (II) n. 1. That which really is, entity, existence, essence; 2. truth, reality; 3. that which is good, सदसद्व्यक्तिहेतवः R.i.10; 4. Brahman (n.).
सत् (III) m. A good man, a virtuous man, निजहृदि विकसंतः संति संतः कियंतः Bhartr.ii.78, सतां सद्भिः संगः कथमपि हि पुण्येन भवति Ut.ii.(सत्कृ ‘to treat with respect.’)

सात् ind. A Taddhita affix which, when put after a word, denotes either a total change of anything into the thing expressed by that word, (e.g. भस्मसात्) or complete control, (e.g. ब्राह्मणसात्), ततो भ्रातुः शरीरमग्निसात्कृत्वा Mal.v., भस्मसात्कृतवतः पितृद्विषः पात्रसाच्च वसुधां ससागराम् R.xi.86.

सत् (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Being, existing; 2. real, essential, true; 3. good, virtuous, chaste, सतीमपि ज्ञातिकुलैकसंश्रयां जनोऽन्यथा भर्तृमतीं विशकते Sak.v.; 4. excellent, best; 5. right, proper; 6. handsome, beautiful; 7. venerable, respectable; 8. wise, learned; 9. firm, steady.
सती f. 1. A virtuous wife, सती प्रियतमा Bhartr.ii.25; 2. female ascetic; 3. name of the goddess Durgā.
सति f. 1. Gift, donation; 2. end, destruction.
साति f. 1. Gaining, acquisition; 2. gift, giving; 3. end, conclusion; 4. destruction; 5. sharp pain.
सत्-कांड m. a hawk, a kite.
सत्-कार m. 1. kind or hospitable treatment; 2. reverence, respect; 3. care, attention; 4. a meal; 5. a festival, a religious observance.
सत्-कुल n. a good family.
सत्-कुलीन a. nobly descended.
सत्-कृत (I) a. 1. done well, acted properly; 2. treated with respect or hospitality; 3. revered, honoured; 4. worshipped, adored.
सत्-कृत (II) m. an epithet of Śiva.
सत्-कृत (III) n. 1. virtue; 2. hospitality.
सत्-कृति f. 1. virtue, morality; 2. treating with respect, hospitality.
सत्-क्रिया f. 1. a good action, charity, virtue; 2. salutation, courtesy, hospitality; 3. any purificatory ceremony; 4. funeral or obsequial ceremonies.
सत्-तम a. best, excellent (person or thing).
सत्-पत्र n. the new leaf of a water-lily.
सत्-पात्र n. a worthy or virtuous person.
सत्-पथ m. 1. good road; 2. correct or virtuous conduct; 3. an orthodox doctrine.
सत्-परिग्रह m. acceptance (of gifts) from a proper person.
सत्-पशु m. a victim fit for a sacrifice.
सत्-पात्र˚वर्ष, ˚वर्षिन् a. of judicious liberality.
सत्-पात्र˚वर्ष, ˚वर्षिन् a. of judicious liberality.
सत्-पुत्र m. 1. a virtous son; 2. a son who performs all the prescribed rites in honour of his ancestors.

सत्-प्रतिपक्ष m. a counterbalanced hetu, one along with which there exists another equally good on the opposite side, [e.g. (1) sound is eternal because it is audible; (2) sound is non-eternal because it is a product] (in logic).
सत्-फल m. the pomegranate tree.
सत्-संनिधान m. the proximity or society of the good, तथा सत्संनिधानेन मूर्खो याति प्रवीणताम् Hit.i.
सत्-संप्रयोग m. right application.
सत्-सहाय a. having virtuous friends.
सत्-सार (I) a. having good essence.
सत्-सार (II) m. 1. a kind of tree; 2. a painter; 3. a poet.
सतत a. (f. ता) Continued, eternal, perpetual.(सततस् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘continually, eternally, always,’ अक्रोधनाः शौचपराः सततं ब्रह्मचारिणः M.iii.192.)
सतत a. (f. ता) Continued, eternal, perpetual.(सततस् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘continually, eternally, always,’ अक्रोधनाः शौचपराः सततं ब्रह्मचारिणः M.iii.192.)
सतत-ग, -गति m. wind, सततगास्ततगानगिरोऽलिभिः Sis.vi.50, नेत्रा नीताः सततगतिना Megh.ii.6.
सतत-ग, -गति m. wind, सततगास्ततगानगिरोऽलिभिः Sis.vi.50, नेत्रा नीताः सततगतिना Megh.ii.6.
सती-त्व n. chastity.
सतीन m. 1. A kind of pulse; 2. a bamboo.
सातीन m. Pease.
सतीर्थ m. A fellow-student.
सतीर्थ m. A fellow-student.
सतील m. 1. A bamboo; 2. air, wind; 3. pease.
सतीला f. Pease.
सतेर m. Husk, chaff.

सत्त्र n. 1. A sacrifice in general; 2. a long sacrificial session lasting from 13 to 100 days; 3. liberality, munificence; 4. good conduct; 5. covering; 6. oblation, offering, gift; 7. fraud, cheating; 8. house, residence; 9. wealth; 10. a wood, a forest, अयमेव मृगव्यसत्रकामः प्रहरिष्यामयि मायया शमस्थे Kir.xiii.9; 11. a tank, a pool.

सत्त्र n. 1. A sacrifice in general; 2. a long sacrificial session lasting from 13 to 100 days; 3. liberality, munificence; 4. good conduct; 5. covering; 6. oblation, offering, gift; 7. fraud, cheating; 8. house, residence; 9. wealth; 10. a wood, a forest, अयमेव मृगव्यसत्रकामः प्रहरिष्यामयि मायया शमस्थे Kir.xiii.9; 11. a tank, a pool.
सत्त्रा ind. With, together with.
सत्त्र-अयण n. a long course of sacrifices.
सत्त्र-अयण n. a long course of sacrifices.
सत्त्रा-हन् m. an epithet of Indra.
सत्त्रिन् m. A householder.

सत्त्व (I) m.n. 1. Being, existence, entity; 2. life, spirit, mind, consciousness; 3. an embryo; 4. substance, wealth; 5. an elementary substance (such as earth, air, fire &c.); 6. any living being, animal, beast, सत्वानामपि लक्ष्यते विकृतिमच्चित्तं भयक्रोधयोः Sak.ii., R.xv.15; 7. an evil being, a demon, a ghost.

सत्त्व (II) n. 1. A substantive, a noun; 2. goodness, virtue, excellence; 3. truth, certainty, reality; 4. strength, energy, courage, self-command, e.g. क्रियासिद्धिः सत्वे भवति महतां नोपकरणेः; 5. the principle of purity or goodness (regarded as the first and best of the three guṇas which are supposed to constitute the external world); 6. any natural property or characteristic.
सत्त्व-अनुरूप a. 1. according to natural disposition; 2. according to means, R.viii.32 (but against Mall.).
सत्त्व-उद्रेक m. excess or predominance of the quality of goodness.
सत्वमेजय a. terrifying living beings, making animals tremble.
सत्त्व-विप्लव m. loss of consciousness.
सत्त्व-विहित a. caused by goodness, virtuous, upright.
सत्त्व-संशुद्धि f. purity of nature or disposition, Bg.xvi.1.
सत्त्व-संप्लव m. 1. universal destruction; 2. loss of vigour.
सत्त्व-सार m. 1. essence of strength; 2. a most powerful person.
सत्त्व-स्थ a. 1. existing in the nature of things; 2. animate; 3. inherent in animals; 4. good, excellent.
सत्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. True, real, महाभूतानि सत्यानि यथात्मापि तथैव हि Yaj.iii.149; 2. faithful, honest, virtuous.
सत्य (II) m. 1. The uppermost of the seven Lokas above the earth; 2. the Aśvattha tree; 3. the deity presiding over the Nāndīmukhaśrāddha; 4. an epithet of Viṣṇu.

सत्य (III) n. 1. Truth, मौनात्सत्यं विशिष्यते M.ii.83, सत्यं ब्रूयात् प्रियं ब्रूयात् M.iv.138; 2. an oath, promise, a solemn asseveration, सत्येन शपयेद्विप्रम् M.viii.113; 3. a demonstrated truth or dogma; 4. the first of the four Yugas of the Hindus.(सत्यम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘truly, indeed, verily,’ सत्यमतीत्य हरितो हरींश्च वर्तन्ते वाजिनः Sak.i., K.S.vi.19.)
सत्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. True, real, महाभूतानि सत्यानि यथात्मापि तथैव हि Yaj.iii.149; 2. faithful, honest, virtuous.
सत्या f. 1. Veracity; 2. an epithet of Sītā; 3. of Satyavatī, the mother of Vyāsa; 4. of Draupadī; 5. of Durgā; 6. of Satyabhāmā.
शत्य a. (f. त्या) 1. Relating to a hundred; 2. bought with a hundred; 3. charged for a hundred; 4. effecting anything with a hundred; 5. containing or consisting of a hundred, Yaj.ii.208.
शत्य a. (f. त्या) 1. Relating to a hundred; 2. bought with a hundred; 3. charged for a hundred; 4. effecting anything with a hundred; 5. containing or consisting of a hundred, Yaj.ii.208.
सत्य-अनृत (I) a. true and false, सत्यानृता च परुषा प्रियवादिनी च Bhartr.ii.17.
सत्य-अनृत (II) n. (practice of truth and falsehood) commerce, trade, traffic, M.iv.4, 6.
सत्य-अभिसंध a. faithful to a promise or agreement.
सत्य-उत्कर्ष m. 1. eminence in truth; 2. true excellence.
सत्य-उद्य a. speaking the truth.
सत्य-काम m. a lover of truth.
सत्यंकार m. 1. making true or good, ratification; 2. something given in advance as security for the performance of a contract.
सत्य-दर्शिन् a. foreseeing truth.
सत्य-धृति a. strictly truthful.
सत्य-पूत a. purified by truth, सत्यपूतं वदेद्वाक्यम् M.vi.46.
सत्य-भामा f. name of the daughter of Satrājit and wife of Kṛṣṇa.
सत्य-युग n. the first of the four ages of the Hindus.
सत्य-वती f. the wife of Parāśara and mother of Vyāsa.
सत्य-वती˚सुत m. an epithet of Vyāsa.
सत्य-वद्य (I) a. veracious.
सत्य-वद्य (II) m. truth.
सत्य-वाच्, -वचस् (I) a. sincere, truthful.
सत्य-वाच्, -वचस् (I) a. sincere, truthful.
सत्य-वचस् (II) m. 1. a saint; 2. a crow.
सत्य-संगर, -संध a. true to one’s word.
सत्य-संगर, -संध a. true to one’s word.
सत्वर a. (f. रा) Speedy, quick, expeditious.
सत्वर a. (f. रा) Speedy, quick, expeditious.
सातत्य n. Continuity.
सातीन m. Pease.

सात्त्विक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Endowed with the quality of Satva; 2. endowed with goodness; 3. belonging to or coming from the Satva quality, ये चैव सात्त्विका भावाः Bg.vii.12; 4. virtuous, amiable; 5. honest, true, good, sincere; 6. produced by feeling or sentiment, तद्भूरिसात्त्विकविकारमपास्तधैर्यमाचार्यकं विजयि मान्मथमाविरासीत् M.M.i.
सात्त्विक (II) m. 1. A Brāhmaṇa; 2. an outward indication of feeling or emotion; (they are eight- स्वेद, वैवर्ण्य, वेपथु, स्तंभ, रोमांच, स्वरविकार, अश्रु and प्रलय); 3. an epithet of Brahman (n.).

सात्त्विक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Endowed with the quality of Satva; 2. endowed with goodness; 3. belonging to or coming from the Satva quality, ये चैव सात्त्विका भावाः Bg.vii.12; 4. virtuous, amiable; 5. honest, true, good, sincere; 6. produced by feeling or sentiment, तद्भूरिसात्त्विकविकारमपास्तधैर्यमाचार्यकं विजयि मान्मथमाविरासीत् M.M.i.
सात्यवत m. A metronymic of Vyāsa.
सात्यवत m. A metronymic of Vyāsa.
सात्वत् m. A follower, a worshipper.
सात्वत (I) m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. of Balarāma; 3. a son of an outcast Vaiśya.
सात्वत (II) m. pl. The name of a people.
सात्वती f. 1. One of the four dramatic styles; 2. name of the mother of Śiśupāla, न दूये सात्वतीसूनुर्यन्मह्यमपराध्यति Sis.ii.11.
